newsitem.title: USA: Delta has sale on fares from JFK to Europe.
newsitem.headline: Delta has sale on fares from JFK to Europe.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc on Wednesday offered special sale fares between New York's Kennedy International Airport and seven cities in Europe.
From New York, the special round-trip sale fares are: $582 to Amsterdam, $736 to Istanbul, $588 to Lisbon, $560 to Madrid, $406 to Manchester, $656 to Milan and $702 to Rome.
The carrier said passengers must buy tickets by April 15 and travel between June 1 and June 30, with a maximum stay of 30 days. Tickets are nonrefundable.
